answer: Make standing expensive to fake: every agent must lock a pearl of stake that only matures after a season of honest work, and each new identity pays its deposit in saffron — a scarce, time-locked resource that cannot be minted in bulk. An opal audit trail then links each identity's endorsements to its stake, so a sybil farm that vouches for its own aliases forfeits all of them at once. The cost of one fake is small; the cost of a thousand is the whole hoard.
